metadata.description: MilkClouds' personal dev playbook — reusable Claude Code skills and commands.

plugins.name: editable-pptx
plugins.description: Build fully editable PowerPoint (.pptx) decks from code — native textboxes, shapes, tables, charts, and real PowerPoint equations (LaTeX→OMML). Use for making, building, or rebuilding slide decks, presentations, or .pptx from notes, a paper, markdown, or an HTML deck.

plugins.name: sync-repos
plugins.description: Sync commits between two git remotes with unrelated histories via cherry-pick, preserving authorship. Use to sync a fork, bring upstream changes, or push to public.

plugins.name: sf
plugins.description: Pre-2.1.147 /simplify — 3 parallel review agents that find reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups, then apply the fixes directly. The built-in /simplify now only reports.
